findings.passage: Ohio now joins the legion of states delivering needless voting restrictions in making the privilege of voting disproportionately difficult, especially for communities of color.
findings.note: Release in his name on HB 458 (strict photo ID and other election changes) becoming law; he describes the bill's voting restrictions as needless and hard on communities of color.

findings.passage: From the beginning, HB 458 was rushed through the Ohio House Government Oversight committee where witness testimony was drastically limited and the impact of strict voter ID laws and the limitations on how and where Ohioans vote was never given proper consideration.
findings.note: Same release: he says HB 458 was rushed in committee and the effects of strict voter ID laws were not properly considered.
